data.name: Yn Moddey Dhoo
data.detailed_description:
For countless nights, the soldiers of Peel Castle kept their distance from the Moddey Dhoo, the black dog. That changed with you.

Yn Moddey Dhoo is an atmospheric first person horror game inspired by indie horror games of the 2000s with visuals mimicking displays of early handhelds and models of the PSX era. The minimal colours make for a dark and oppressive feeling that hangs over the player like the threat of the large black dog. Explore the claustrophobic corridors and winding staircases to discover the dark secrets below.

You are Edward Christian, a soldier stationed in Peel Castle in the year 1666. Each night in the soldiers' barracks, an imposing black dog wanders and lays down in front of the fire. The soldiers of the castle fear the dog, but leave it be. One night, the drink gets the better of you, and you challenge the beast to follow you as you take the castle key to the Captain of the Guard alone. Traverse the Castle as the Moddey Dhoo stalks you.

Features

  • Gaze into the eyes of the Moddey Dhoo for too long, and find yourself losing control

  • Lock up the castle without trapping yourself

  • Choose what you carry carefully

  • Get to the hearth rooms to restore your sanity

  • 1-bit dithered visuals inspired by old handhelds

  • PSX-inspired low-poly models

  • Based on the Manx folklore of Peel Castle

  • Told through the native Manx language with translations

Gaelgagh

Ta'n Moddey Dhoo ny ghamman atçhim chied-pheiagh lane dy ghooie goaill bree veih gammanyn atçhim neuchroghagh ny bleeantyn 2000 lesh jallooyn ta jannoo arrish er scaaghyn ny chied ghammanyn laue as cummaghyn lhing y PSX. Ta ny daaghyn goan jannoo magh ennaghtyn dorraghey as tranlaasagh ta croghey harrish y chloieder gollrish baggyrt y voddey mooar doo. Ronsaghey ny corydoryn chionn as ny greeishyn cassey dy gheddyn magh ny folliaghtyn dorraghey heese.

Uss Edward Christian, sidoor ta soit ayns Cashtal Purt ny h-Inshey 'sy vlein 1666. Dagh oie ayns thieyn-vaghee ny sidooryn, ta moddey doo mooar shooyl mygeayrt as lhie sheese kiongoyrt rish yn aile. Ta aggle er sidooryn y chashtal roish y voddey, agh t'ad faagail eh ny lomarcan. Un oie, ta'n jough cur y varriaght ort, as t'ou cur slane ny lhie er y vaagh dy eiyrt ort choud's t'ou goaill ogher y chashtal gys Captan y Ghard dty lomarcan. Gow trooid y Chashtal choud's ta'n Moddey Dhoo shelg ort.

Troaryn

  • Jeeagh ayns sooillyn yn Moddey Dhoo rish tammylt roud, as bee oo coayl smaght ort hene

  • Cur y caishtyl fo ghlass gyn oo hene y ghabbal ayns ribbey

  • Reih dy kiarailagh ny t’ou cur lhiat

  • Fow gys ny çhymlee dy gheddyn dty cheeayl er ash

  • Jallooyn dithered 1-bit er nyn stroiee liorish shenn ghreieyn-laue

  • Cowreyn low-poly er nyn stroiee liorish y PSX

  • Bunnit er beeal-çhiree Vannin mychione Cashtal Phurt ny h-Inshey

  • Innit trooid y Ghaelg as çhyndaayssyn rish

data.short_description: The first narrative Manx Gaelic language game. A 1-bit dithered first-person horror based on Manx folklore. The Moddey Dhoo, an imposing black dog, stalks the corridors of Peel Castle. Run. Hide. Escape. Don't look into its eyes; they might be the last thing you see.
